# Private local security backport

This package contains deepmerge4.3.1 plus the prototype-poisoning fix from upstream PR274, commit c5ad573121574db1c625b0aabcc6114ed7df6c5a. Version4.3.2+wppconnect.1 identifies this private local patch and its4.x compatibility; it is not an upstream release and is never published to a registry. The original package name is preserved for transitive dependency matching. The is-mergeable-object1.1.0 helper is included locally. Both libraries are MIT-licensed; original notices are preserved.
